caption_L1: This line graph is labeled Number of homicides by firearm in the United States from 2006 to 2019. Number of homicides is measured along a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 12,000 on the y-axis. Year is drawn along a linear scale from 2006 to 2018 along the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: From 2006 to 2011 the number of homicides steadily decreases. In 2012 the number of homicides slightly increases, to the drop again until 2014, hitting a low point of 8000 homicides per year. After 2014, the number of homicides massively increases and in 2017 hits the highest point. After 2017, the trend decreases again, but not in a significant way. The number of homicides per year never goes lower than 8000.
